items.q: a second concerto for cello which I wrote for Ed Laut

ctx.x: Dennis Russell Davies, and a second concerto for cello which I wrote for Ed Laut, which is for jazz band and cello. There’s a flute concerto for Pellerite, James Pellerite. There’s three – four saxophone concertos: one for Lee Konitz, one for the guy . . .
